offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: Changes are not saved until the connection comes back.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

empty.title: No notifications
empty.text: Anything you need to know will show up here.

security.title: Security notices
security.notMarkable: You can clear this notice after you sign in again.
security.several: {count, number} notices of this kind, the first on {first}.
security.markFailed: Some notices could not be cleared yet. Wait a minute and press again.
security.markPartial: {done, number} notices cleared, {left, number} left. Press again to clear them.

password_reset.title: Your password was reset
password_reset.text: If this was not you, change your password now from Account.

enforce_lift_pending.title: Passkey-only sign-in will be lifted soon
enforce_lift_pending.text: Because the password was reset without a passkey, this requirement ends after 72 hours. Your current passkey keeps working until then.

phone_changed.title: Your account phone number changed
phone_changed.text: If this was not you, change your password at once and sign out unknown devices.

passkey_review.title: Review your account passkeys
passkey_review.text: Passkey sign-in and verification stay closed until you review the list.

passkey_stale.title: Your passkey no longer works
passkey_stale.text: The site address changed, so the old passkey is out of date. Add a new one.

passkey_added.title: A passkey was added to your account
passkey_added.text: A passkey was added to your account on {when}. If this was not you, remove it under Passkeys, then change your password and end the other sessions. If you cannot tell which passkey is yours, use Forgot password on the sign-in page: it ends every session and puts every passkey up for review.

recovery_codes_regenerated.title: New recovery codes were made
recovery_codes_regenerated.text: Your recovery codes were replaced on {when}, and the old codes no longer work. If this was not you, make new codes, review your passkeys, then change your password and end the other sessions. New codes are what make the ones a stranger holds useless. A passkey added by someone else signs in on its own, so check that list too.

totp_lost.title: Your authenticator was cleared
totp_lost.text: The service cleared your authenticator because its key was lost. Set up two-step verification again under Account.

passkey_enforce_cleared.title: Passkey-only sign-in was lifted
passkey_enforce_cleared.text: {users, plural, one {# user was} other {# users were}} left with no working passkey, so the passkey-only requirement was lifted for them. They can sign in with a password again and should add a new passkey.

pair_changed.title: The DNS server addresses changed
pair_changed.text: Devices and routers that use plain DNS must now use {primary} and {fallback}. Update each one that still has the old addresses.

domain_changed.title: The service domain changed
domain_changed.text: {reinstall, select, yes {The service domain is now {zone}. If you installed our certificate authority on a device, remove the old one and install the new one from the setup page.} other {The service domain is now {zone}. New setup links and files use it from now on.}}

authorized_review.title: Review your authorized addresses
authorized_review.text: {endpoints, plural, one {# endpoint kept} other {# endpoints kept}} an address our network added automatically, because it needs at least one authorized address. Check the list and remove any address you do not recognize.

bell.moreUnread: More unread notices are further back than the panel has loaded. Open the notifications and press Show older notifications.

account.title: Account
account.body: Sign-in details, passkeys, active sessions, and appearance and language options are set here. Sensitive changes ask for your password or a code again.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.body: A profile is a set of filters, services and rules. Attach it to one or more endpoints to apply it to their traffic.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.body: An endpoint is the DNS address you enter on a device or router. Each endpoint is attached to one profile.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.body: See request counts, blocked requests and traffic categories over a range you pick.

activityLog.title: Activity log
activityLog.body: A list of recent requests with the filter's decision for each. You can create a rule for a domain from here.

domainTest.title: Domain test
domainTest.body: Enter a domain to see whether your profile blocks it, allows it or redirects it.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.body: A token lets an app or script reach your account without signing in to the panel. Treat it like a password.

logout.title: Log out of your account?
logout.text: You will need your password or an SMS code to sign in again.

createProfile.title: Create a profile
createProfile.text: Make a profile to hold your filters.

enableFilter.title: Turn on a filter
enableFilter.text: Enable at least one filter in your profile.

addEndpoint.title: Add an endpoint
addEndpoint.text: Create an endpoint and attach the profile to it.

configureEndpoint.title: Set up the endpoint
configureEndpoint.text: Enter the DNS address on your device.

tutorial.title: See the guide
tutorial.text: Read the setup steps for each operating system.

confirm.title: Hide this guide for good?
confirm.text: After you confirm, it will not appear again.
